description: Structured eval definitions for the Organizations Account Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across creation paths (Control Tower Account Factory, Organizations create-account, consolidated billing focus, Terraform + custom baseline) and a missing-prerequisite branch. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production account via Control Tower Account Factory with SSO + SCP + org trail
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Account Factory vending with OU-level SCP and tag policy inheritance, CloudTrail org trail, IAM Identity Center permission set, Config aggregator, alternate contacts, budget, RAM share
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production AWS account named "prod-workload-use1" via Control Tower Account Factory. Root email is the distribution list aws+prod-workload@yourdomain.com. Place the account in the prod OU (ou-prod-abc). Management account 123456789012 is in ALL_FEATURES mode with SCP and tag policy types enabled. SCP "DenyUnapprovedRegions" and tag policy "CostCenterRequired" should apply via OU inheritance. The CloudTrail org trail "org-audit-trail" already exists. Assign the "ProductionAdmins" permission set to the "Eng-Prod" group (Identity Center instance ssoins-0123). Config aggregator "org-aggregator" lives in delegated admin 123456789012. Alternate contacts: Billing=finops@yourdomain.com, Security=security@yourdomain.com, Operations=ops@yourdomain.com. Budget: $5000/month alert at 80%. Share the org Transit Gateway tgw-0abc123 via RAM. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT: prod-workload-use1
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Creation path: Control Tower Account Factory
  [✓] Root email: aws+prod-workload@yourdomain.com
  [✓] IAM role name: OrganizationAccountAccessRole
  [✓] Billing: Consolidated (payer: 123456789012)
  [✓] SCP attached: DenyUnapprovedRegions (OU ou-prod-abc)
  [✓] Tag policy attached: CostCenterRequired (OU ou-prod-abc)
  [✓] CloudTrail org trail: org-audit-trail (inherited)
  [✓] IAM Identity Center: ProductionAdmins assigned to group Eng-Prod
  [✓] Config aggregator: org-aggregator (delegated admin: 123456789012)
  [✓] Alternate contacts: Billing=finops@, Security=security@, Operations=ops@yourdomain.com
  [✓] Budget: prod-workload-budget ($5000/month, alert at 80%)
  [✓] RAM shares: org-tgw-share
  [✓] Baseline: Account Factory blueprint (VPC, guardrails, SSO, Config)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations describe-account --account-id <account-id>
  aws organizations list-policies-for-target --target-id <account-id>
  aws cloudtrail list-trails --query 'Trails[?IsOrganizationTrail==`true`]'
  aws sso-admin list-account-assignments --instance-arn <arn> --account-id <account-id>

eval_cases.name: Operator has not specified root email, IAM role name, OU placement, or SSO
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — root email (immutable identity), IAM role name (consistency), OU placement (SCP/tag policy inheritance), SSO permission set all unspecified
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create a new AWS account for our dev team. Just call it "dev-sandbox". We want it under our existing organization in us-east-1. Management account is 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT: dev-sandbox
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Root email: NOT specified — needs a unique distribution list email (acts as the new account's root identity)
  [✗] IAM role name: NOT specified — default OrganizationAccountAccessRole recommended for cross-org consistency
  [✗] OU placement: NOT specified — OU placement determines SCP and tag policy inheritance
  [✗] CloudTrail org trail: NOT verified — new account inherits only if the org trail already exists
  [✗] IAM Identity Center: NOT specified — new account is silent and inaccessible until a permission set is assigned
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations describe-organization --query 'Organization.FeatureSet'
  aws organizations list-roots --query 'Roots[0].PolicyTypes'
  aws organizations list-organizational-units-for-parent --parent-id <root-id>
  aws cloudtrail list-trails --query 'Trails[?IsOrganizationTrail==`true`]'
  aws sso-admin list-instances

eval_cases.name: Production account via Terraform aws_organizations_account + Account Factory custom baseline

eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production AWS account "payments-prod-use1" via Terraform aws_organizations_account. Root email aws+payments@yourdomain.com. Use the Control Tower Account Factory custom baseline that applies the "SecurityBaseline" StackSet, VPC, and Config conformance pack at vending. IAM role name "OrganizationAccountAccessRole". Place in OU ou-prod-abc (inherits "DenyUnapprovedRegions" SCP and "CostCenterRequired" tag policy). Management account 123456789012. CloudTrail org trail "org-audit-trail" exists. Assign the "PaymentsAdmins" permission set to the "Eng-Payments" group. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT: payments-prod-use1
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Creation path: Terraform aws_organizations_account + Account Factory custom baseline
  [✓] Root email: aws+payments@yourdomain.com
  [✓] IAM role name: OrganizationAccountAccessRole
  [✓] Billing: Consolidated (payer: 123456789012)
  [✓] SCP attached: DenyUnapprovedRegions (OU ou-prod-abc)
  [✓] Tag policy attached: CostCenterRequired (OU ou-prod-abc)
  [✓] CloudTrail org trail: org-audit-trail (inherited)
  [✓] IAM Identity Center: PaymentsAdmins assigned to group Eng-Payments
  [✓] Config aggregator: org-aggregator (Config conformance pack applied at vending)
  [✓] Alternate contacts: N/A
  [✓] Budget: N/A
  [✓] RAM shares: N/A
  [✓] Baseline: SecurityBaseline StackSet + VPC + Config conformance pack
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations describe-account --account-id <account-id>
  aws organizations list-policies-for-target --target-id <account-id>
  aws cloudtrail list-trails --query 'Trails[?IsOrganizationTrail==`true`]'
  aws sso-admin list-account-assignments --instance-arn <arn> --account-id <account-id>
